title: GitHub - woshidsqj/mutmutmut: Mutation testing system
body: To work with the results, use mutmut browse where you can see the mutants, retest them when you've updated your tests. You can also write a mutant to disk from the browse interface, or via mutmut apply . You should REALLY have the file you mutate under source code control and committed before you apply a mutant!

body: In pyproject.toml, mutmut v3 requires path-shaped settings to be arrays. paths_to_mutate = "src/" (a scalar string) is accepted in setup.cfg but rejected or silently ignored under [tool.mutmut]; keep the brackets.
